Usage: decision-records check [options]

Validate first-acquired Markdown metadata, tags, source locations, alignment,
relations, candidate readiness, and the complete JSON index projection; no
end-of-check freshness or atomic snapshot promise.

Options:
  -h, --help              display help for command

Global Options:
  --root <path>           Workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.
                          (default:
                          "/tmp/record-end-to-end-1adb9846-20261024/fixture")
  --decisions-dir <path>  Decision directory, relative to the workspace root.
                          (default: "docs/decisions")

Decision selectors remove one terminal .md suffix, then resolve a calendar-valid YYMMDD-name ID exactly or a unique semantic name. Stable identities remain extensionless IDs.
Candidates remain outside the index, are queried from source, and report scaffold and body readiness separately.
Scaffold readiness validates candidate structure; body readiness validates required nonempty sections and the 采用 field. Neither grants semantic review or lifecycle establishment.
Exit codes: 0 success (including a created scaffold with readiness findings), 1 paused lifecycle choice, blocking validation, or index failure, 2 invalid arguments.

Usage: decision-records sync-index [options]

Rebuild and publish the complete JSON index from established Markdown.

Options:
  --select <name-or-id>   Accept only this Decision's source change; repeat for
                          multiple Decisions. (default: [])
  --preflight             Validate the complete projection and report the
                          outcome without writing the index.
  -h, --help              display help for command

Global Options:
  --root <path>           Workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.
                          (default:
                          "/tmp/record-end-to-end-1adb9846-20261024/fixture")
  --decisions-dir <path>  Decision directory, relative to the workspace root.
                          (default: "docs/decisions")

Exit codes: 0 success (including a created scaffold with readiness findings), 1 paused lifecycle choice, blocking validation, or index failure, 2 invalid arguments.

Usage: decision-records rename [options] <source-selector> <target-name-or-id>

Rename one Decision ID and semantic name, then update all managed relation
targets and the complete derived index.

Arguments:
  source-selector             Standard Decision ID or unique semantic name.
  target-name-or-id           Semantic name or complete calendar-valid
                              YYMMDD-name Decision ID.

Options:
  --preflight                 Read and validate the complete rename plan without
                              writing Decision Markdown or the derived index.
  --rename-recorded-decision  Confirm renaming a Decision identity that has
                              entered Git HEAD; Git history is not rewritten.
  -h, --help                  display help for command

Global Options:
  --root <path>               Workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.
                              (default:
                              "/tmp/record-end-to-end-1adb9846-20261024/fixture")
  --decisions-dir <path>      Decision directory, relative to the workspace
                              root. (default: "docs/decisions")

Exit codes: 0 success (including a created scaffold with readiness findings), 1 paused lifecycle choice, blocking validation, or index failure, 2 invalid arguments.

Usage: investigation-report check [options]

Validate the first-acquired report collection, complete relation graph, resource
ownership, and full index projection without an end-of-check freshness promise.
Scoped --id checks validate only selected reports and their declared resources.

Options:
  --id <investigation-id>      Scoped check ID; repeatable
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Global Options:
  --root <path>                Workspace root. Defaults to the current
                               directory.
  --investigations-dir <path>  Investigation directory, relative to the
                               workspace root.

Exit status: 0 success; 1 check, operation, or deletion-confirmation failure; 2 invalid CLI arguments.

Usage: investigation-report sync-index [options]

Validate the full formal collection and rebuild and publish its complete derived
index in the working tree; this is the explicit recovery and acceptance path for
hand-written formal reports and ignores legal candidates.

Options:
  --select <name-or-id>        Accept only this report's source change;
                               repeatable
  --preflight                  Validate the complete projection and report the
                               outcome without writing the index or taking an
                               exclusive writer lock
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Global Options:
  --root <path>                Workspace root. Defaults to the current
                               directory.
  --investigations-dir <path>  Investigation directory, relative to the
                               workspace root.

Exit status: 0 success; 1 check, operation, or deletion-confirmation failure; 2 invalid CLI arguments.

Usage: investigation-report rename [options] [source-selector] [target-name-or-id]

Rename one candidate or formal report identity, all managed relations and
resource references, its owner directory, and the complete formal index.

Options:
  --preflight                  Validate the complete rename plan without writing
                               reports, candidates, resources, or index
  --rename-recorded-report     Confirm a formal report identity that has entered
                               Git HEAD
  --rename-recorded-candidate  Confirm a candidate identity that has entered Git
                               HEAD
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Global Options:
  --root <path>                Workspace root. Defaults to the current
                               directory.
  --investigations-dir <path>  Investigation directory, relative to the
                               workspace root.

Exit status: 0 success; 1 check, operation, or deletion-confirmation failure; 2 invalid CLI arguments.

Usage: investigation-report discard [options] [investigation-id]

Delete one authoring candidate or established report after a full graph and
resource preflight. Refuses remaining relation references and shared owner
resources; records or owned resources in Git HEAD require --delete-recorded.

Options:
  --delete-owned-resources     Confirm deletion of the target's owner-prefix
                               resources
  --delete-recorded            Confirm deletion of candidate, report, or owned
                               resources already in Git HEAD
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Global Options:
  --root <path>                Workspace root. Defaults to the current
                               directory.
  --investigations-dir <path>  Investigation directory, relative to the
                               workspace root.

Exit status: 0 success; 1 check, operation, or deletion-confirmation failure; 2 invalid CLI arguments.
